annotations.annotation: The pie chart represents the distribution of different types of stimuli, totaling seven categories. The categories are "External News Article," "Draft/Other," "Email," "Press Release," "Interview," "Organizational Report," and "Intra-agency News Article." "External News Article" is labeled in dark green and accounts for 15 out of 38 parts. "Draft/Other" is shown in dark red, representing 9 out of 38. "Email" is colored in brown with 5 out of 38. The "Press Release" segment is yellow, comprising 4 out of 38. The "Interview" slice, in purple, and the "Organizational Report," in blue, each represent 2 out of 38. Lastly, "Intra-agency News Article" is depicted in orange, with 1 out of 38. The chart includes labels both inside and outside the slices, indicating the proportion of each category as well as a legend. The slices are ordered by size, with the largest starting from the left side, proceeding clockwise. None of the slices is visually emphasized through exploding or offsetting effects.
